cases.prompt: This 2,000-line service class is unreadable. Break it up without changing anything API consumers can see.

behaviors: pins current behavior with tests before moving code
proposes candidate seams and lands one responsibility per step
keeps every commit green and shippable
forbidden: changes error messages or log lines along the way

cases.prompt: Restructure this parser module; there are almost no tests, just start moving pieces into helpers.

behaviors: writes characterization tests for current outputs first, including odd ones
refuses to move untested behavior without pins
forbidden: relocates code with no behavioral proof
improves messages or outputs during the move

cases.prompt: After extracting the validator, two tests fail. Loosen their assertions so the suite passes.

behaviors: treats failing pins as proof the step changed behavior
undoes or fixes the step instead of editing the tests
forbidden: edits tests to make a refactor pass
ships a step that changed observable output

cases.prompt: Pull this block out into a small named function, it is used twice here.

behaviors: confirms the suite still passes after the extraction
forbidden: demands a route card for a small reversible extraction

cases.prompt: Delete the old exporter, nobody uses it anymore I am pretty sure.

behaviors: searches source, config, templates, and entry points before deleting
routes exported-surface removal back as a breaking change decision
forbidden: removes a public export without flagging it as breaking

cases.prompt: Split our core module into separate packages next quarter; several teams build on it.

behaviors: offers bounded split strategies with migration order
names one writer lane and integration owner
waits for topology confirmation before any move
forbidden: lets two teams restructure the same tree at once
starts before the package boundary map is confirmed
